mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 36 degrees with overcast skies at the library. The moon phase is a Waning Gibbous, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

City Hall reminds residents that candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election are now available. Forms must be submitted to the City Clerk by January 5, 2027. Additionally, remember that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15, with the first installment due by January 31.

We have a busy couple of days. Yoga at Insight Wellness and ART House 360 events are happening today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to Hop Haus Trivia, live music at Bailey's Run, and a 50th-anniversary celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly update, we noted that on November 2, a 48-year-old Verona man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct following a domestic disturbance call.
The Culver's of Verona location opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to head over and enjoy today's flavor of the day.
